title: Color--Phase Separation for Mixed Random Operators in Two-Speed Stochastic Klein--Gordon Systems
summary: We study a two-component stochastic fractional Klein--Gordon system on the three-dimensional torus with fractional dispersion exponent \(α\), distinct propagation speeds, and a pure cross nonlinearity. The singular mixed terms combine a low--high paraproduct inside a Duhamel integral with an outer resonant product. Their structure is governed by two index pairs: the color pair determines the possible Gaussian contraction, whereas the propagator--input pair determines the Duhamel phase. In every same-color block generated by the interaction graph, the outer propagator has a different speed.…
